# Write-free e2e: catalog list / show (embedded metadata only).

# list text — sorted unit ids from embed.
exec foundry catalog list
stdout '^cli\tarchetype\t'
stdout '^core\tcore\t'
stdout '^distribution\tprofile\t'
stdout '^tui\tarchetype\t'
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# list JSON — digest + units schema.
exec foundry catalog list --output json
stdout '"schema":1'
stdout '"command":"catalog list"'
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"catalog_digest"'
stdout '"units"'
stdout '"id":"cli"'
stdout '"id":"core"'
! stderr .
dump_digest stdout

# show core (hit)
exec foundry catalog show core
stdout 'id=core'
stdout 'kind=core'
stdout 'catalog_digest='
! stderr .

# show cli archetype
exec foundry catalog show cli
stdout 'id=cli'
stdout 'kind=archetype'
! stderr .

# show JSON includes digest matching version catalog field shape.
exec foundry catalog show core --output json
stdout '"ok":true'
stdout '"catalog_digest"'
stdout '"id":"core"'
! stderr .

# unknown id → catalog.invalid + available set (exact IDs only).
! exec foundry catalog show does-not-exist-unit
stderr 'catalog.invalid'
stderr 'available units'
stderr 'cli'
stderr 'core'
assert_error_id stderr catalog.invalid

# JSON unknown
! exec foundry catalog show does-not-exist-unit --output json
stdout 'catalog.invalid'
stdout '"ok":false'
! stderr .
assert_error_id stdout catalog.invalid
